items.name: data-grid
items.title: Data Grid
items.description: A composable, high-performance data grid: range selection, spreadsheet clipboard, typed cell editors, validation, and windowed rendering at 100k+ rows.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-presence
items.title: Data Grid Presence
items.description: Multiplayer presence add-on for the gridcn data grid: useDataGridPresence registers an overlay plugin that paints remote users' live selections as named, colored highlights, with zero core re-renders.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-fill
items.title: Data Grid Fill
items.description: Fill-handle add-on for the gridcn data grid: drag-to-tile with series inference (arithmetic runs, zero-padded numbers, prefix+number sequences), mod+D/mod+R keyboard fill, via the overlay-plugin seam, with zero core re-renders.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-pinned-rows
items.title: Data Grid Pinned Rows
items.description: Pinned top/bottom row bands add-on for the gridcn data grid: useDataGridPinnedRows registers a rowBands spec (e.g. a totals row) that stays sticky under the header or at the viewport's bottom edge, pixel-aligned with data rows and pinned columns. useDataGridAggregate computes filter-aware sum/avg/min/max/count for those bands.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-history
items.title: Data Grid History
items.description: Undo/redo add-on for the gridcn data grid: op-based, id-keyed history plus a useDataGridState quick-start wrapper.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-toolbar
items.title: Data Grid Toolbar
items.description: Toolbar add-on for the gridcn data grid: quick-search with match navigation, a per-column filter menu (aligned rows, join column, drag-to-reorder via @dnd-kit/react), and a column visibility/pin menu.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-context-menu
items.title: Data Grid Context Menu
items.description: Right-click context menus for the gridcn data grid: cut/copy/paste/clear/row operations on cells, sort/pin/hide/autosize on headers.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-keybindings
items.title: Data Grid Keybindings
items.description: Keyboard shortcuts dialog for the gridcn data grid, generated at runtime from the grid's effective keymap, grouped by category with platform-aware key chips; opens via '?' or a trigger.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-url-state
items.title: Data Grid URL State
items.description: Syncs the gridcn data grid's sort/filter/search state with the URL via nuqs (router-agnostic — requires a NuqsAdapter above it). Mount <DataGridUrlState prefix?> inside the provider; the prefix option namespaces the URL keys for multiple grids on one page.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-io
items.title: Data Grid IO
items.description: Import/export add-on for the gridcn data grid: xlsx and csv, with delimiter detection and preview. New user-facing strings live under `labels.io` (see lib/labels.ts DataGridIOLabels) — export button/menu, import dialog (file picker, header-row toggle, delimiter select, column mapping, preview, errors).
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-lazy
items.title: Data Grid Lazy
items.description: Virtual data fetching add-on for the gridcn data grid: useDataGridLazyRows maintains a sparse data array and fetches row windows on demand from onRowWindowChange, with range coalescing, in-flight dedup, abort-on-unmount, and error revert/refetch. A dev-only DataGridLazyGuard warns when uncontrolled sort/filter/search fires while rows are still unloaded.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-pagination
items.title: Data Grid Pagination
items.description: Pagination add-on for the gridcn data grid: useDataGridPagination (client mode slices data; server mode is fully controlled) plus a composable <DataGridPaginationBar /> footer (range, page-size select, first/prev/pages/next/last parts) — shadcn-Pagination style, renders a default layout with no children or a custom composition of parts. New user-facing strings live under labels.pagination (see data-grid/labels.ts DataGridPaginationLabels). Zero core changes — purely additive.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-sort-list
items.title: Data Grid Sort List
items.description: Toolbar sort add-on for the gridcn data grid: a sort button + popover listing applied sorts as editable, aligned rows (column / direction / remove / drag handle), with add/clear-all and precedence reordering via @dnd-kit/react drag or ArrowUp/ArrowDown on the grip (array order in SortSpec[]). New user-facing strings live under labels.sort (see data-grid/labels.ts DataGridSortLabels). Zero core changes — purely additive.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-minimal-demo
items.title: Data Grid Minimal Demo
items.description: The quick-start minimum: the core item alone, `defaultData`, zero app-side state.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-streaming-demo
items.title: Data Grid Streaming Demo
items.description: A live ticker: `updateCells` streams values in place. An auto-sort switch toggles between defer (rows hold position, re-sort on demand) and immediate (correct order every tick).
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-demo
items.title: Data Grid Demo
items.description: The hero demo: an editable grid with every built-in cell type, range selection, the free data-grid-fill add-on, and native clipboard, via defaultData with zero state wiring.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-cell-types-demo
items.title: Data Grid Cell Types Demo
items.description: Every built-in cell type in one grid, plus a read-only column, a validate rule, and a custom renderCell override.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-custom-cell-demo
items.title: Data Grid Custom Cell Demo
items.description: A worked custom cell type: currency storage as a plain number, cached locale-formatted display, and a symbol-stripping fromText, registered via the cellTypes prop.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-sorting-filtering-demo
items.title: Data Grid Sorting & Filtering Demo
items.description: Toolbar quick-search with match navigation, a per-column filter menu, and click-to-sort headers with multi-column sort.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-history-demo
items.title: Data Grid History Demo
items.description: Undo/redo via the useDataGridState quick start, with toolbar buttons wired to the returned history object.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-context-menu-demo
items.title: Data Grid Context Menu Demo
items.description: Right-click cell menu (cut/copy/paste/clear, row operations) and header menu (sort/pin/hide/autosize) via the header dropdown.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-keybindings-demo
items.title: Data Grid Keybindings Demo
items.description: A shortcuts dialog generated at runtime from the grid's effective keymap, opened via a toolbar button or the '?' shortcut.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-io-demo
items.title: Data Grid IO Demo
items.description: Import/export toolbar buttons: export downloads the current view as xlsx or csv; import parses a file and replaces the grid's data through onDataChange.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-url-state-demo
items.title: Data Grid URL State Demo
items.description: Sort/filter/search/pagination state synced to the URL via nuqs; wrapped in the Next.js app-router NuqsAdapter (swap for your framework's adapter).
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-row-markers-demo
items.title: Data Grid Row Markers Demo
items.description: rowMarkers modes (none/number/checkbox/both): a pinned-left marker column outside the data index space, switchable at runtime.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-custom-headers-demo
items.title: Data Grid Custom Headers Demo
items.description: Column header as a React component: a three-state sort icon (minus / up / down) driven by useDataGridSortState(); header click sorts in sort mode, and a custom header owns its display.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-custom-markers-demo
items.title: Data Grid Custom Markers Demo
items.description: Custom row marker renderers (renderMarker/renderMarkerHeader): a lucide icon marker reflecting the row selection state, and a select-all header button, while the marker cell's own press/drag gestures still select rows.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-pinning-demo
items.title: Data Grid Pinning Demo
items.description: Column pinning (left/right), resize (incl. a resizable:false column and a flex:1 long-content column for double-click autosize), and drag-to-reorder, with the header dropdown menu for pin/unpin/autosize and a toolbar columns menu for show/hide.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-large-data-demo
items.title: Data Grid Large Data Demo
items.description: 100k generated rows proving row virtualization: only the windowed rows around the viewport ever mount.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-performance-demo
items.title: Data Grid Performance Demo
items.description: 100k generated rows with a top-left FPS meter overlay so the scroll-performance claim is checkable live.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-pinned-rows-demo
items.title: Data Grid Pinned Rows Demo
items.description: Totals and averages rows pinned under the header, recomputed live from the grid's data on every edit, and filter-aware via a toolbar filter menu on the Role column.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-conditional-styling-demo
items.title: Data Grid Conditional Styling Demo
items.description: An HR dataset showing all four value-driven styling surfaces: grid-level getRowClassName/getCellClassName plus per-column cellClassName/headerClassName, all using shadcn theme tokens.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-styling-patterns-demo
items.title: Data Grid Styling Patterns Demo
items.description: A fully-styled brand column (per-column cellClassName/headerClassName), a fully-styled at-risk row (getRowClassName beyond a bg tint), and a live density/rowHeight toggle.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-lazy-demo
items.title: Data Grid Lazy Demo
items.description: 100k rows, only a handful loaded up front; a simulated-latency in-memory API fetches each scrolled-into window on demand, with skeleton rows filling in as data lands.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-pagination-demo
items.title: Data Grid Pagination Demo
items.description: Client-mode pagination: useDataGridPagination slices a generated dataset and <DataGridPaginationBar /> renders the default footer (first/prev/pages/next/last, page-size select, range label).
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-sort-list-demo
items.title: Data Grid Sort List Demo
items.description: Toolbar sort button + popover: add/remove sorts, toggle ascending/descending, and reorder precedence via drag handle or ArrowUp/ArrowDown keyboard.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-presence-demo
items.title: Data Grid Presence Demo
items.description: 3 simulated users move cell/range selections on a timer via useDataGridPresence's setPresenceHighlights (2 in view-space range form, 1 rowId-native), with toolbar avatar chips, one user periodically overlapping another, and headerClickBehavior="sort" proving the rowId-native highlight follows its row through a sort.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-events-demo
items.title: Data Grid Events Demo
items.description: Grid with a live inspector panel pretty-printing the latest payload per event: onDataChange, onSelectionChange, onSortChange, onFilterChange/join, onFill, onRowWindowChange, onColumnLayoutChange, and a presence read-back button.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-validation-demo
items.title: Data Grid Validation Demo
items.description: Five rejection paths in one grid: a sync function (Age), a sync Standard Schema (Email), an async Standard Schema with a visible pending state (SKU), and a coercing schema (Price). A button pastes a mixed valid/invalid block onto Age to show the bulk-rejection path.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-cell-errors-demo
items.title: Data Grid Cell Errors Demo
items.description: A fake saveOrders rejects any committed Quantity over 100 after ~600ms; the onDataChange handler calls actions.setCellErrors to paint the exact cell with the same ring/tint/aria-invalid treatment as a live validate rejection, after commit. A badge reads the count via useDataGridCellErrors(), and a Clear all button calls clearCellErrors().
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-i18n-demo
items.title: Data Grid I18n Demo
items.description: A locale Select (English/Deutsch/Arabic) where each locale carries its strings and its text direction: labels, column headers, and hint text translate via deep-merged overrides, and the Arabic locale flips the grid to RTL through the direction prop.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-fill-patterns-demo
items.title: Data Grid Fill Patterns Demo
items.description: A staged dataset with a numeric series (1,2,3), a zero-padded series (001,002), a text-plus-number series (Item 1,2,3), and a plain-text column — dragging the fill handle down each shows series extrapolation vs. plain tiling; Alt/Option forces a copy and Ctrl/Cmd+D/R do the same from the keyboard.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-loading-demo
items.title: Data Grid Loading Demo
items.description: Two Switches (loading, rows present) reach all three states of the loading prop: zero rows + loading = viewport-filling skeleton, rows present + loading = a slim indeterminate bar under the header, zero rows + not loading = the ordinary empty state.
items.author: gridcn

items.name: data-grid-playground-demo
items.title: Data Grid Playground Demo
items.description: Every add-on composed in one grid: toolbar, context menu, fill, undo/redo, keybindings, sort list, import/export, plus independent toggles (row markers, pinned totals, validation, read-only, loading, RTL, presence, streaming, density, header click) and an exclusive virtualized/paginated/lazy mode select.
items.author: gridcn
